Experiment: Full-frame solid-wall span anchors for the E1M1 moving-sector wall-scale mismatch

SavedReplayComparison.Interpretation: At height 68 the candidate removes the three mapped-column wall-color mismatches; all 18 remaining differences are floor/ceiling plane pixels. Height 34 retains four non-plane differences. This is a comparison against the adapted PowerShell reference, not the original executable.

PartitionCheck.TimingLimit: Five fixed views with process startup excluded but renderer/JIT warm-up included. The per-view timings are diagnostic and are not a broad throughput estimate.

IsolatedSerialTiming.Interpretation: The candidate median is 5.2% higher and P95 is 14.1% higher. These are isolated serial full-frame render calls; they exclude simulation, audio, worker scaling, encoding, terminal output and displayed FPS.

Disposition: Not adopted. It restores seven-process partition parity and removes three height-68 wall-color differences, but the repeated full-screen visibility bookkeeping slows isolated renders and leaves 18 plane mismatches. A shared host-computed span table remains a possible lower-cost design.
ValidationScope: Saved replay and in-memory serial/process rendering only. No live game, display, keyboard or audio device was used.
